first_night.narration.1: The Sun is going down, Commander. Our solar panels can’t make power in the dark, so the batteries must do all the work tonight.
first_night.narration.2: And Mars nights get very cold!
first_night.dialogue.1: Heating uses a lot of power. But the plants need to stay warm!
first_night.dialogue.2: Warm and cozy, or save power for tomorrow? Hmm.
first_night.question: How warm should we be tonight?
first_night.A.label: Full heating (Power −15, Life +2)
first_night.A.after: Everyone is toasty! Heating used power, so tomorrow’s sunshine matters.
first_night.B.label: Half heating (Power −8, Life −2)
first_night.B.after: A bit chilly, but we saved some power. Careful planning is part of every mission.
first_night.C.label: Heat the greenhouse only (Power −4, Life −5)
first_night.C.after: The plants are safe, but the crew is cold. We kept most of our power, though we feel it in our toes!
first_night.classroom: Why do batteries matter when the Sun goes down?
first_night.cargo.batteries: Our battery upgrade helps with tonight’s power use.
